data: Which language pair has higher BLEU scores across all values of T?

The question asks which language pair has higher BLEU scores across all values of T. From the caption, we can see two lines representing the BLEU scores for EN-DE and ZH-EN. The blue line represents EN-DE, and the red line represents ZH-EN. By analyzing the graph, it is clear that the blue line (EN-DE) consistently stays above the red line (ZH-EN) across all values of T. Therefore, the language pair with higher BLEU scores across all values of T is EN-DE.
